paragraphs.text:
You hear nothing to disturb your watch. At midnight, you yawn 
and cross the tiny circle of firelight to where Bernard Ebstein 
sleeps, whispering to wake him up. When the student makes no 
sound, you probe the shadows with the toe of your boot. You 
feel only sandy soil beneath the empty blankets.

Concerned,  you  repeat  Bernard’s  name,  louder. The  other 
members of your party scramble out of their bedrolls, bleary 
and asking questions.

“Be silent!” barks Charlie. She takes a brand from the campfire 
and  holds  it  aloft,  passing  it  over  the  ground  surrounding 
Bernard’s  blankets.  She  pauses.  The  brand  trembles  in  her 
brown, leathery fist. 1

Even your amateur eye can spot the marks impressed into  (
the earth. You ask Charlie if they are the tracks of a raccoon.

“Not a raccoon,” the guide whispers in an odd tone. She says 
no more. Can you convince her to open up?
Make a Persuade roll: if you succeed, go to 14; if you fail, go to 15.
